question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

On the back foot
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On the back foot"** means being in a disadvantaged or defensive position. (असुविधाजनक स्थिति में)

 
 
• **Example:** The team was on the back foot after losing two early wickets in the match.
 
 
 
• **"At a disadvantage"** refers to being in a weaker position compared to others, especially in a competition or conflict. (नुकसान में)
 
 
• **Example:** The company was at a disadvantage because of its outdated technology.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "On the back foot" aligns with the meaning "At a disadvantage."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In a relaxed state** (आराम की स्थिति में): Being calm and free from stress or tension.

 
 
• **Example:** After finishing his exams, he was finally in a relaxed state.
 
 
 
• **Situated farther away** (दूर स्थित): Being located at a greater distance.
 
 
• **Example:** The village is situated farther away from the city center.
 
 
 
• **In a hurry** (जल्दी में): Acting quickly or rushing to complete something.
 
 
• **Example:** He left the house in a hurry and forgot his wallet.
